sentences.en: The machi-bikeshi were organized into some forty-odd brigades named after the letters of the iroha syllabary, each responsible for its assigned neighborhoods.

sentences.en: Firefighting in those days, however, did not mean putting fires out with water as it does today.

sentences.en: The sight of firefighters climbing onto roofs holding their brigade standards aloft, marking their brigade's post with no regard for the flying sparks, won the cheers of the people of Edo and was depicted many times in ukiyo-e prints.

sentences.en: Behind the dazzling performance, the memory of a city that fought fire again and again still quietly lives on.
